metadata.name: [SRE] K8s multi-pod restart burst
metadata.description: P2: ≥2 pods in the same deployment each gained ≥1 restart in the lookback (excludes datadog-agent-injected). Wakes investigation without naming OOM.

breach.query:
FROM metrics-k8sclusterreceiver.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE `metrics.k8s.container.restarts` IS NOT NULL
| WHERE `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name` != "datadog-agent-injected"
| WHERE `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name` IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_r = MAX(`metrics.k8s.container.restarts`),
        min_r = MIN(`metrics.k8s.container.restarts`)
    BY `resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.pod.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name`
| EVAL delta = max_r - min_r
| WHERE delta >= 1
| STATS crashing_pods = COUNT_DISTINCT(`resource.attributes.k8s.pod.name`),
        total_delta = SUM(delta),
        max_pod_delta = MAX(delta)
    BY `resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name`
| WHERE crashing_pods >= 2 AND total_delta >= 2
| KEEP `resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name`,
       crashing_pods,
       total_delta,
       max_pod_delta
